name: Platelet adhesion and aggregation via VWF–GPIb-IX-V
rationale: All members concern platelet adhesion, activation or aggregation, with a VWF–collagen–GPIb-IX-V core (including VWF and ADAMTS13 variant defects) that the coagulation-cascade and GPVI/receptor-signalling confusables lack.

core: Potassium channel control of membrane potential
name: Potassium channels setting resting potential and hyperpolarization
rationale: Members are K+ channel families (Kv, Kir, KCa, TASK, KATP/ABCC9) and their regulation of resting potential and hyperpolarization, whereas the confusables centre on cardiac action-potential plateau and repolarization phases.

core: Sulfur and aromatic amino acid metabolism
qualifier: with selenium, BH4, vitamin B6 and molybdenum cofactor
name: Sulfur, selenium and aromatic amino acid metabolism with cofactors
rationale: Members cover transsulfuration/cysteine/sulfide catabolism, phenylalanine-tyrosine catabolism and their cofactors (BH4, PLP, MoCo), plus selenium compound metabolism, which separates the theme from the glutathione, urea-cycle and general amino-acid confusables.

name: Lipid droplet triglyceride catabolism and lipophagy
rationale: All members concern breakdown of stored triglyceride by lipolysis, lipophagy or droplet disassembly, unlike confusables about droplet formation/adipogenesis or fatty acid beta-oxidation.

name: Upper glycolysis from hexokinase to fructose bisphosphate
rationale: Members describe glucose breakdown through glucose-6-phosphate and fructose 1,6-bisphosphate including hexokinase deficiency, distinct from hypoxia-driven glycolysis, glycogen, fructose and fructose-2,6-bisphosphate confusables.

core: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and transcriptional repression
name: MECP2 methyl-DNA binding and NCoR–HDAC corepression
rationale: Members are MECP2 binding to 5mC/5hmC DNA and NCoR/SMRT, its phosphorylation and HDAC histone deacetylation, whereas confusables emphasise MECP2 neuronal target genes and behaviour.

name: Arterial smooth muscle tone in vasoconstriction and blood pressure
rationale: All members regulate arterial smooth muscle contraction/relaxation and resulting systemic or pulmonary pressure, unlike renin-angiotensin, natriuretic/cGMP and generic smooth-muscle relaxation confusables.

qualifier: prenylation of RAS and RAB GTPases
name: Prenylation and lipid modification of RAS and RAB GTPases
rationale: Members concern protein lipidation, chiefly geranylgeranylation and C-terminal processing of RAB and RAS small GTPases, whereas confusables involve palmitoylation, Wnt/Hedgehog lipidation or delipidation.

qualifier: centred on cobalamin and folate–methionine one-carbon cycle
name: Vitamin cofactor metabolism centred on cobalamin and folate–methionine cycle
rationale: Members span uptake, transport and metabolism of vitamins (B12, folate, B1, B2, biotin, E) with SAM/methionine one-carbon metabolism and its inborn errors, separating it from carnitine, selenium and mitochondrial acyl-CoA confusables.

name: Serotonin and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signaling
rationale: Members are serotonin receptor and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signalling via adenylate cyclase or PLC, distinct from histamine, tachykinin, PDE and nicotinic confusables.

name: HPA axis glucocorticoid secretion and stress response
rationale: Members describe CRH/ACTH-driven glucocorticoid secretion and responses to cortisol, corticosterone and stress, distinct from confusables on mineralocorticoid synthesis, feeding/neuropeptide behaviour and growth hormone/prolactin.

qualifier: large neutral (aromatic and branched-chain) amino acids
name: Large neutral amino acid transmembrane transport
rationale: Members transport leucine, isoleucine, phenylalanine and tryptophan (plus SLC6A14/SLC22A18 transporter variants), whereas confusables handle proline/glycine, peptides, small neutral or cationic amino acids.

qualifier: NFE2L2 target genes and AKT-regulated FOXO
name: NFE2L2 and AKT–FOXO stress-responsive transcription
rationale: Members are NFE2L2-driven antioxidant/detoxification gene programmes and AKT-controlled FOXO transcription, combining the two arms each confusable has only one of.

qualifier: assembly/disassembly and inositol phosphate and Rev transport
name: Nuclear pore complex dynamics and inositol phosphate transport
rationale: Members concern NPC assembly, mitotic disassembly/reformation and NPC-mediated traffic of inositol phosphates and HIV Rev, distinct from nuclear envelope breakdown, mRNA/ribosome export and protein import confusables.

qualifier: Th2 differentiation with eosinophil and mast cell activation
name: Th2-driven eosinophil and mast cell activation
rationale: Members link Th2 differentiation to eosinophil activation, migration and mast cell activation, whereas confusables cover granulocyte differentiation or IL-4/IL-5/IL-13 cytokine production.

name: Phagocyte respiratory burst and hydrogen peroxide regulation
rationale: Members regulate NADPH-oxidase superoxide/ROS generation and hydrogen peroxide synthesis and catabolism in phagocytes, while confusables emphasise anti-inflammatory macrophage signalling or neutrophil degranulation and killing.

name: Nociceptive detection of thermal and mechanical stimuli
rationale: All three members are detection of stimuli in pain perception, unlike the NGF/TRKA neurotrophin and K2P channel confusables.

name: Integrin–ILK focal adhesion actin bundling and crosslinking
rationale: Members are actin crosslinking, bundle and network formation tied to integrin signalling and the PINCH-ILK-parvin focal adhesion complex, which the actin-dynamics confusables lack.

name: Hurler, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy mucopolysaccharidoses
rationale: All members are MPS I, IV or VI glycosaminoglycan-degradation disorders, distinguished from confusables containing MPS II, III, IX or generic GAG degradation.

qualifier: GnRH, LH/FSH secretion and glycoprotein hormone receptor response
name: GnRH–LH/FSH gonadotropin axis and gonadal response
rationale: Members span GnRH response, LH/FSH secretion, glycoprotein hormone receptors and gonadal (Sertoli, follicle, germ cell) responses, distinct from ovulation/luteinization and activin-signalling confusables.

name: Trophoblast differentiation and placental labyrinth development
rationale: Members describe trophoblast proliferation, migration and giant-cell endoreduplication, chorio-allantoic fusion, labyrinth vasculature and decidualization, unlike mammary, ovarian or early embryo lineage confusables.

qualifier: marrow cell proliferation, survival and number homeostasis
name: Bone marrow development and cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members concern bone marrow development, proliferation, apoptosis and cell-number homeostasis (with M-CSF and VENTX), distinct from thymic T-cell and HSC confusables.

qualifier: myristoylated and VxPx cargo, cytosolic ciliogenesis
name: Ciliary cargo targeting and cytosolic ciliogenesis
rationale: Members are targeting of myristoylated and VxPx-motif cargo to the cilium and cytosolic ciliogenesis, unlike intraflagellar transport, Golgi trafficking and photoreceptor confusables.

qualifier: NUDT pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Nucleotide pool sanitization and thiopurine drug metabolism
rationale: Members cover NUDT-mediated hydrolysis of (deoxy)nucleoside triphosphates protecting DNA and azathioprine/TPMT thiopurine handling, separate from pyrimidine catabolism, purine synthesis/salvage and nucleoside transport confusables.

qualifier: membrane protrusions and motility via ROCK/PAK effectors
name: Actin dynamics in membrane protrusion and cell motility
rationale: Members regulate actin polymerization, severing and bundling for filopodia, ruffles, podosomes, macropinocytosis and migration, including ROCK/PAK effectors and focal adhesion, whereas confusables are RHO GTPase cycles or capping/microtubule processes.
